page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre above the title block; page number top left. Title block at full width (Emblema heading, motto title, subtitle). Below it a framed woodcut emblem (no text inside the frame). Below the woodcut, centred verse of four lines. Catchword "Mani-" at lower right.

main_text.head: EIICE PRIMVM TRABEM ex oculo tuo.
main_text.p: [woodcut emblem: two figures on pedestals, an owl on a stump, and a beam through one figure's eye; no text inside the frame]
main_text.l: Faex odiosa virum næuis intenta propinqui.
Non curat proprii crimina tanta laris:
Excute stulte trabem prius, ac festuca notetur:
Sis turpi liber crimine censor, age.

page.notes: The woodcut is a framed emblem picture with two figures, peacock-like pedestals, an owl on a stump and a beam piercing one figure's eye. The title line "EIICE" is printed as shown; the word reads Eiice in the source. The verse lines use long s printed as plain s. Catchword "Mani-" is the start of the next page's word, shown as printed.
